messages:
maya: kicking off tonight's llm-route deploy, deploying v2.14.2 -> v3. small staged FF ramp. deploybot queued the run. :rocket:

deploy-bot: [info] Started rollout for release v2.14.2 on service llm-route. change window 23:00-02:00 UTC.

maya: plan is staged feature-flag ramp with cooldowns and auto-rollback on safety triggers. config below:
```
ff: llm_route_v3_enabled
ramp: 1%, 5%, 20%, 50%, 100%
hold_between_steps: 10m
rollback_if: error_rate > 1.5x baseline OR p99_latency increase > 100ms
safety_pin: pin_to_version=v2.14.1 on partial outage
manual_approvers: [maya, ops_lead] after 01:00 UTC
```

ravi: +1. what exact signals will trigger auto-rollback vs pause? :eyes:

maya: auto-rollback triggers are error_rate and p99 latency conditions above. pause if oscillation in request success or sudden token-cost jump. pauses will extend hold to 20m and reduce next step.

ops_lead: i'm oncall for the window. prefer: immediate 50% pin to previous version on a partial outage, then full rollback if mitigation fails. note that policy must be executable by deploybot.

jamie: suggest adding a parity-check for prompt-quality: monitor hallucination rate on sampled eval prompts. if hallucination delta > 3x, treat like a hard-fail and rollback.

maya: added hallucination check to the safety rules. deploybot acked the update.

deploy-bot: [ack] FF ramp schedule saved. next step (1% -> 5%) scheduled at +10m. telemetry baseline captured: baseline_errors=0.6%, baseline_p99=240ms, baseline_halluc=0.4%.

ravi: prod-release-notes updated with rollout notes and rollback playbook link: https://redwood/docs/releases/v2.14.2. also added quick commands for emergency pin:
```
# emergency pin to previous
/deploybot pin llm-route v2.14.1 --reason "emergency"
```

maya: decision rules recap: if we hit error_rate > 1.5x during a hold, immediate auto-drain and pin; if oscillation occurs between 20->50, reduce to 30% and extend hold to 20m; manual override required for destructive actions after 01:00 UTC.

ops_lead: agreed. set manual override to require two approvers for any rollback past 01:00 UTC (helps night shift).

deploy-bot: [note] manual override configured. gate updated: approvers=[maya, ops_lead].

maya: I'll call a showstopper if alerts persist beyond the second hold. tagging @ravi @jamie on monitoring. :thumbsup:

jamie: watching logs and analyzer pipelines, will call out prompt-regression if we see spike.

sre-bot: [monitor] active metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, hallucination-sampler, token-cost-delta. alerting thresholds set per playbook.

maya: closing thread for now — will post updates at each ramp step. if anyone wants to opt-out of auto-rollback for a specific cohort, speak now.
